jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 24c (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/managers/version/stale.mjs, tools/phone-commands.mjs, tools/policy-run.mjs, tools/release-train-update.mjs, tools/report-commands.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/managers/version/stale.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/managers/version/stale.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 270 `} catch { /* no local board registry */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError on reading the board registry file only, log the rest (e.g. a connection error from `readBoardServerVersions` reaching a registered-but-unreachable board); no fallback value, board staleness finding simply isn't added.
- Line 282 `} catch { /* remote off */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError on reading the remote state file only, log the rest (e.g. a connection error reaching a registered-but-unreachable remote); no fallback value, remote staleness finding isn't added. ALSO stay silent for error?.code === 'ECONNREFUSED' (remote board not running is the normal "remote off" state); also check error?.cause?.code for fetch errors.

### tools/phone-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/phone-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 41 `const ledger = await readLedger(project.root).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (a corrupt ledger must be visible, so SyntaxError is logged) (no ledger yet, or torn write), log the rest; keep null fallback (handled via `ledger?.tickets ?? []`).
- Line 43 `} catch { /* a project that cannot be read is skipped */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (project root gone/unreadable), log the rest (e.g. a real bug in `collectInbox`/`phoneItems`); no fallback value, project is skipped from `items`.

### tools/policy-run.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/policy-run.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 345 `} catch { /* ignore secondary log failure */ }` (around `await journal(errEntry);`): lost audit write — LOG-ALWAYS, include the item id; no fallback value, `errors`/`left` are still updated below regardless.

### tools/release-train-update.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/release-train-update.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 123 `} catch { /* offline or no remote */ }`: SILENT-<nonzero git exit code> (`git ls-remote` with no network/remote), log the rest (e.g. git not found); no fallback value, `latestTagged` stays null.
- Line 129 `} catch { /* tag-only remote need not have main */ }`: SILENT-<nonzero git exit code> (`git show origin/main:package.json` when main doesn't exist on the remote), log the rest; no fallback value, `originMainVersion` stays null.

### tools/report-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/report-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 14 `try { return await fs.readFile(path.join(root, file), 'utf8'); } catch { /* the next one */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (one of the candidate scope files doesn't exist), log the rest; no fallback value, loop tries the next candidate file.
- Line 42 `const ledger = await readLedger(root).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (a corrupt ledger must be visible, so SyntaxError is logged) (no ledger yet, or torn write), log the rest; keep null fallback (checked right after via `if (!ledger) return out(...)`).

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
